contributors.approvedSummary: I felt uncertain about my marriage and anxious about family expectations. I eventually learned that I needed space for my own questions before hearing more opinions. This is my experience, not a recommendation for anyone else's situation.
Family pressure made it hard to talk about my relationship. I tried setting boundaries with a relative, but the conversation was complicated when people began taking sides.

milestones.title: Too many opinions
milestones.whatHappened: I was uncertain about my marriage and worried about my family's reaction.
milestones.whatIActuallyTried: Read several discussions and asked broadly for opinions.
milestones.whatDidNotHelp: Conflicting advice left me more confused.

milestones.title: A different kind of conversation
milestones.whatHappened: I realized I wanted space to think before another person offered a verdict.
milestones.whatIActuallyTried: Wrote down my questions and asked a trusted friend to listen first.
milestones.whatHelped: The conversation helped me explain what mattered to me.

milestones.title: More clarity, still uncertainty
milestones.whatIActuallyTried: Continued reflecting and considered qualified support.
milestones.whatHelped: I could describe my priorities more clearly, according to my own reflection.

milestones.title: A complicated family conversation
milestones.whatHappened: I worried about telling relatives I was uncertain about my relationship.
milestones.whatIActuallyTried: Set a boundary before talking to one relative.
milestones.whatHelped: Preparing what I wanted to communicate gave me more confidence.
milestones.whatDidNotHelp: Some relatives took sides, which was difficult.

peerQuestionDemo.questionText: How did you find space to understand what you wanted when your family had strong opinions?

response.label: Fictional contributor reply — demo simulation
response.text: I didn't find an immediate answer. I started by writing down what was important to me, then asked one trusted friend to listen without deciding for me. That was my experience; it might not fit yours. I hope you find a space where you can work out what matters to you.

sampleApprovedInsight: I think I want a conversation where someone listens before suggesting what I should do.
